name: facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlalgos/simple_ddqn/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlalgos/si.create_QAgent: create a QAgent instance with a model and number of actions for epsilon-greedy action selection
facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlalgos/si.call_QAgent: call the QAgent to select actions using epsilon-greedy policy based on observation frames
facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlalgos/si.update_QAgent: update the QAgent model weights by loading a new state dictionary
facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlalgos/si.create_DQMLP: create a DQMLP neural network with dueling architecture for value and advantage estimation
facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlalgos/si.forward_DQMLP: run a forward pass through the DQMLP network to compute Q-values from state inputs

facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlalgos/si.create_replay_buffer: create a ReplayBuffer with capacity N to store and sample experience transitions for DQN training
facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlalgos/si.push_transitions_to_buffer: push trajectory transitions into the ReplayBuffer using the push method for experience replay
facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlalgos/si.sample_replay_buffer: sample n random transitions from the ReplayBuffer for training the DQN agent
facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlalgos/si.run_ddqn_training: run the DQN training loop with config, environment factory, and agent factory to learn a policy
facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlalgos/si.compute_ddqn_loss: compute the double DQN loss from sampled transitions using the learning and target models

facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlalgos/si.run_DDQN_CartPole: run a Double DQN experiment on the CartPole-v0 Gym environment with configurable hyperparameters
facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlalgos/si.create_env_GymEnv: create a list of Gym environments wrapped with TimeLimit and return as GymEnv or GymEnvInf
facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlalgos/si.create_agent_QAgent: create a QAgent instance with a given model and number of actions for DQN training
facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlalgos/si.create_model_DQMLP: create a DQMLP neural network module with weight initialization for the observation space and action count
facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlalgos/si.flatten_dict: flatten a nested dictionary or DictConfig into a single-level dictionary with slash-separated keys
